controlled_receiver_only_profile.method: Debug-only direct JNI profile on Realme. One warm-up preceded each fixed text length. Native timestamps separate SentencePiece encode, opaque CT2 translate_batch, and SentencePiece decode. The profile was stopped on thermal status 3 during the first long sample.

medium.text: Please send medical rescue to my location now.

stage_conclusion.ct2_preprocessing: SentencePiece encoding was <=3.738 ms and decoding <=1.657 ms.
stage_conclusion.ct2_encoder: Not separately measurable through the deployed CT2 translate_batch API.
stage_conclusion.ct2_decoder: Not separately measurable through the deployed CT2 translate_batch API.
stage_conclusion.ct2_inference: The opaque combined CT2 native inference call consumed essentially all translation time.
stage_conclusion.translation_to_tts_enqueue: P1.16 receiver handoff proceeded directly after translation; no queue backlog was observed.
stage_conclusion.tts: P1.16 warm Hindi synthesis was 181.5-197.9 ms. Its 2360.4 ms tail was run-1 cold model load (2007 ms) plus first native call, not warm architecture cost.
stage_conclusion.audiotrack: Prior P1.15A profiling measured preparation ~14-22 ms and write <0.1 ms; P1.16 playback is generated speech duration (~962-1068 ms), not startup overhead.

memory_thermal.decision: No thread/affinity/lifecycle experiment was attempted or promoted after thermal escalation.

experiments.name: A/B/C: beam=1 and model/tokenizer/session reuse verification
experiments.result: PASS_CONFIGURATION; one model load and reuse in controlled session

experiments.name: D/E: thread or CPU-affinity changes
experiments.result: NOT_RUN; no evidence justified changing CT2 runtime configuration, and thermal status reached 3

experiments.result: MEASURED; latency scaled sharply from short to medium to long

experiments.name: G: lifecycle scheduling / GC correlation
experiments.result: INCONCLUSIVE; no GC or scheduler trace was captured, so no causal claim

recommended_next_step: Keep the current CT2/TTS configuration. Cool device and, if needed, repeat only a controlled thermal-aware receiver profile; do not run Telugu/Kannada work.
